_about: Studio voice-over for the launch intro. tools/vo-elevenlabs.js renders each line to desktop/vo/<id>.mp3; the game plays them instead of the system voice and times every scene to its clip. 'say' is what the voice reads (it may carry <break> tags and phonetic spellings); the on-screen caption stays the line in src/js/late/89-z-cine.js. Keep every id matching a scene id there.

lines.say: Long ago, the World Tree held up the sky... its roots binding every island to the stars.
Islanders built their homes in its branches. <break time="0.3s" /> And every night, they sent lanterns up to the stars.
Then the Eclipse came. <break time="0.4s" /> The sky shattered... and the roots fell silent.
Islands tumbled from the sky, and one by one, the roots went dark.
Six guardians, twisted by the dark, broke loose upon the world.
For a hundred years, the world waited... <break time="0.4s" /> for someone to wake.
Then, deep beneath the roots, a lone wanderer awoke.
Their first friend was a sprout. <break time="0.35s" /> A small... very loud sprout.
A spark of fallen starlight became their wings.
Their first flight went... <break time="0.5s" /> about as well as you would expect.
So they practised. And practised. <break time="0.25s" /> And practised some more.
They crossed the shattered islands, from crystal caves to burning peaks.
The dark struck them down, again and again. <break time="0.45s" /> But every time, they stood back up.
And they never had to face the dark alone.
Build. <break time="0.2s" /> Mine. <break time="0.2s" /> Fish. <break time="0.2s" /> Climb. <break time="0.3s" /> And mend the roots.
Root by root, the light came back, and the islands rose to meet the sky.
